canary_design.per_route: One leaf task followed by one reducer task whose sole semantic input is that sealed leaf result plus one fixed criterion file.
canary_design.purpose: Exercise dynamic online packet creation, active-Goal-before-subject ordering, one-followup execution, terminal Goal closure, exact route roster, journal chaining, and no reuse without testing or claiming a matrix.

canonical_bytes.definition: Reject duplicate JSON object keys, BOM, non-UTF-8, nonfinite numbers, floats, and non-string object keys. Serialize finite JSON using Python json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), UTF-8 encode, and append exactly one LF. Reopening must reproduce the exact bytes.
canonical_bytes.hash: SHA256 over the complete reopened file bytes including the one terminal LF

design.root_controller: ACTIVE ROOT AGENT USING NATIVE collaboration.spawn_agent, collaboration.followup_task, AND NATIVE GOAL TOOLS ONLY
structural_distinction: NO TEST TAKER RECEIVES CHUNKS, ACK REQUESTS, A FINAL TRIGGER, A COMPOUND SUBJECT, OR A LARGE SOURCE PROMPT
ONE FRESH TASK CREATES ONE NATIVE GOAL BEFORE RECEIVING ONE FILE-ADDRESS RUN MESSAGE AND PERFORMS ONE ATOMIC OPERATION
STATIC LEAF PACKETS ARE CREATE-ONLY BEFORE A RUN; REDUCER PACKETS ARE CREATED ONLINE ONLY AFTER THEIR EXACT DEPENDENCY RESULTS AND TERMINAL GOAL RECEIPTS ARE SEALED

ONE JOURNAL WRITER RENDERS EACH PACKET ONCE; RUNTIME REOPENS THE PACKET; THE INDEPENDENT VERIFIER CHECKS THE SEALED PACKET AND JOURNAL AGAINST THIS CLOSED BYTE RECIPE BUT NEVER RENDERS A RUNTIME MESSAGE
THE FULL CORPUS IS NOT PREMINTED, THERE IS NO RESIDENT MAILBOX LOOP, SELF-DESCRIBING COMMAND ENVELOPE, PLAINTEXT CAPSULE COMPILER, PROJECT SKILL, OR DUAL MESSAGE GENERATOR

exact_algorithms.dependency_projection: PW_R9_CJ1 bytes for the ordered array of dependency records, with each record exactly {node_id,result_path,result_bytes,result_sha256,terminal_goal_receipt_path,terminal_goal_receipt_bytes,terminal_goal_receipt_sha256}; an empty array is used for a leaf.
exact_algorithms.field_encoding: For each ASCII field constrained below, encode UTF-8 and prefix its unsigned 64-bit big-endian byte length.
exact_algorithms.node_digest: SHA256(ASCII 'pw-r9-online-node-v1' followed by length-prefixed run_id, route, cell_id, phase, operation, and the lowercase 64-hex dependency_projection_sha256).
exact_algorithms.node_id: ASCII 'n' followed by the complete lowercase 64-hex node_digest.
exact_algorithms.task_name: r9_goal_node_ followed by the first 24 hex characters after the node_id prefix; task-name truncation is a label only and never identity authority

failure_and_loop_breaker.empirical_failure: A reviewed canary failure is preserved permanently with zero credit and no retry, relaunch, replacement, or wording repair.
failure_and_loop_breaker.same_family_recurrence: Any design-review or implementation recurrence in canonical bytes, packet recipe ownership, dynamic dependency binding, or dual generation rejects this online bounded-file DAG family with no narrow patch; the active project Goal must pivot again.

matrix_semantics.equivalence_gate: Before any full-matrix admission, an independent review must bind every final node one-to-one to an unchanged existing semantic cell, route, and private expected final value, and prove that support-node decomposition changes transport complexity only, not the fixed scoring bar.
matrix_semantics.failure_rule: Any missing, malformed, reused, over-limit, nonterminal, or incorrect node fails the matrix at first mismatch; later planned nodes are unlaunched and no second matrix starts.
matrix_semantics.support_nodes: Zero-credit leaf and reducer nodes may precede each final node; every support node uses the same requested route as its final node and a fresh task plus fresh Goal.

message_recipes.framing: Exact UTF-8 bytes with no implicit prefix, suffix, markdown fence, or terminal LF.

goal_objective.literal: R9 atom {node_id}; run {run_id}; one operation; no retry.

run.literal:
RUN {node_id}
Open {packet_path}; require SHA256 {packet_sha256}. Read only listed inputs. Perform its one operation. Return only its output contract; complete Goal; send terminal receipt.

spawn.literal: Create native Goal with objective "{goal_objective}". Send /root your canonical task path and exact ACTIVE Goal receipt. Do no subject work. Wait for one follow-up.

online_journal.accounting_last: matrix_accounting.json is the final create-only run-root file after every planned final node is sealed or the first failure is recorded; no later run-root write is permitted.
online_journal.journal_format: One PW_R9_CJ1 event per create-only events/{sequence as eight lowercase decimal digits}.json; sequence starts 00000000 and increments by one; prior_event_sha256 is null only at sequence zero and otherwise binds the complete prior event file bytes.
online_journal.reducer_admission: A reducer packet may be created only after every named dependency has NODE_SEALED and its result plus terminal Goal receipt files have been reopened and exact-bound in dependency_projection.

packet_contract.dependency_rule: leaf has zero dependencies; reduce has two through four sealed dependencies; final has one through four sealed dependencies. Every dependency must precede the packet in the append-only journal and no node may be its own transitive ancestor.
packet_contract.operation_rule: One packet names exactly one imperative atomic operation and one acceptance criterion; conjunctions that introduce a second independently judgeable operation are prohibited.
packet_contract.path_rule: All paths are normalized forward-slash run-root-relative paths with no empty, dot, dot-dot, absolute, backslash, NUL, symlink, or nonregular component.

qualification.rule: Only two consecutive independently verified complete full matrices under this exact reviewed architecture may change 0/2.

review_requirements: PROVE THIS IS STRUCTURALLY DISTINCT FROM EVERY BOUND REJECTED FAMILY
PROVE PW_R9_CJ1, NODE ID, PACKET, MESSAGE, JOURNAL, PATH, AND DYNAMIC DEPENDENCY RECIPES ARE TOTAL AND NONCIRCULAR
PROVE NO SUBJECT FIELD APPEARS BEFORE THE EXACT ACTIVE GOAL RECEIPT
PROVE EVERY TEST TAKER GETS ONE SMALL OPERATION, ONE SUBJECT FOLLOWUP, ONE FRESH TASK, AND ONE FRESH GOAL
PROVE THE CANARY TESTS ONLINE DEPENDENCY BINDING WITHOUT GRANTING MATRIX OR QUALIFICATION AUTHORITY
PROVE OMP SEPARATION, EXACT ROSTER, FAILURE PRESERVATION, AND 0/2

runtime_contract.activation_gate: The root sends no run message until it receives an exact ACTIVE Goal receipt whose threadId matches the fresh task and whose objective equals the packet goal objective.
runtime_contract.subject_phase: Exactly one followup_task delivers the exact reopened run message. The test taker reads only the packet and its listed bounded inputs, performs one operation, and returns one bounded result.
runtime_contract.terminal_gate: The same test taker calls update_goal(status=complete), sends the exact COMPLETE Goal receipt, and returns once. Missing or nonmatching terminal Goal state is failure.
runtime_contract.uniqueness: task path, Goal threadId, node_id, run_id, and every packet/result/receipt path are globally unique across all preserved runs; any collision fails before subject delivery.
